$description: State layer tokens for interactive feedback. Defines opacity values for hover, focus, press, and drag states per Google Material Design 3 specifications.

state-layer.$description: M3 state layer opacity values for surface color overlays

opacity.$description: State-specific opacity percentages applied to surface color

hover.$description: 8% opacity on hover. Subtle acknowledgment of pointer presence.

focus.$description: 12% opacity on keyboard focus. More prominent for accessibility.

press.$description: 12% opacity on press/active. Same as focus for consistency.

drag.$description: 16% opacity during drag. Highest prominence for active manipulation.

disabled.$description: 38% opacity for disabled state. M3 disabled content opacity.

selected.$description: 8% opacity for selected items. Same as hover but persistent.

duration.$description: Total ripple animation duration. Scale + fade out.

enter.$description: State layer enter duration. Fast response to interaction.

exit.$description: State layer exit duration. Slightly slower for smooth departure.

easing.$description: Standard M3 easing for state transitions.

color-blend.$description: How state layer blends with surface

mode.$description: Standard alpha compositing. State layer on top of surface.

inherit-from.$description: State layer uses on-surface color (adapts to light/dark theme).
